The Map tab is the picked country's satellite map with a bubble per city (its best score), country chips over it; under it Always get (every Rainbow dish), the city chips, and Vacation's GO BACK / SKIP / NOT RATED. A city opens on its restaurants as score pins, the tapped one a card. Best (Best | Most eaten at) and Search (names, cities, dishes) tabs. A restaurant: its map (Google Maps on a tap), the stamps card (ten a card), We ate here, its score and every dish with Vacation's stars (halves, ×N, Rainbow); Edit with Where I am or a Google Maps link, Country and City.

control.label: Control
control.subject: Morphe: the family's patched YouTube, made on the Pi and kept up to date by a small app. The Pi (morphe/pi, morphe-build.timer every 3 hours) takes the newest stable Morphe patches, gets the YouTube they are made for from APKPure, uses it only when every APK in it carries Google's own YouTube signature, patches it and signs it with one key that never changes; with MicroG-RE it is served at morphe.chhat.net behind a key, never on the public apps repo. A failure keeps the last build and says why. The app (slug morphe, sky blue) sets a phone up once from a QR (allow installs, remove an old Morphe made with another key, MicroG, YouTube), then shows Up to date and Open YouTube; every new build goes in silently while the screen is off and nothing plays. Build 1 = YouTube 21.23.492, patches v2.3.0, MicroG 7.3.2. Tests: build + server 15 (8 mutants red), Plan 7 (3 red), the page in jsdom through every step (6 red). Asked: "make my own update for morphe for them where it auto updates", "youtube only. just mom dad and my phone".

Time opens on the Thai day as one bar of 24 hours coloured by what each stretch is called (ตี, เช้า, เที่ยง, บ่าย, เย็น, ทุ่ม, เที่ยงคืน), its name and hours under it; every time has a clock face in its part of the day's colour, so bar, clock and word agree (a test keeps them so). The foot is the two icons only, the open one in the accent on a soft pill. javacheck 24/24. reddit.label: Reddit
reddit.subject: Reddit: Curated and All tabs, read posts no longer greyed. Curated is one list that keeps going as you scroll: the top posts of all your communities at once (followed and visited), for the month, year or all time, never one you have read. Subs became All (r/all, Hot / Top today / New); your communities are under You. Posts you had opened faded to a third (pictures too); now they look like any other post, and Unread only still hides them. 41+ checks pressing the page through, a Curated-shows-read mutant red. Asked: "Idk why imgs and text is gray fix it. Also for surprise i more meant curated where i can scroll for new content. Remove subs replace it with all please".
